content.text: Entacapone with a nonselective MAOI (eg, phenelzine, tranylcypromine) could inhibit most catecholamine metabolism; it can be taken with selective MAO-B inhibitors (eg, selegiline). Give drugs metabolized by COMT (eg, isoproterenol, epinephrine, norepinephrine, dopamine, dobutamine, methyldopa, apomorphine) with caution, by any route.
